content.xhtml:p: 30 s hold. IN = AtTemp AND Cooking, so it RESETS if temp drops. Milk must be held continuously. This is the pasteurization and the rung the attack defeats.
State machine: Fill -> Cook -> Hold -> Empty, in two latches.
Heat only during the cook phase. Also the dry-fire interlock.
BatchSafe = full hold met. Divert defaults ON (fail-safe) and only c lears when the batch is safe.
I controller with anti-windup - holds 63 C without overshoot.
